handling.guidance: One facet per prescription as issued, dated the day of the sight test. The id is <provider-slug>:<date>, the slug the visit.clinic for the same test uses, so the two read together. Powers are dioptres as printed, signed (+3.25 is 3.25, -1.00 is -1), axis in whole degrees; a cell the prescription leaves blank is left out, never written as 0. kind says what the lenses are for; a contact lens prescription is a facet of its own, not folded into the spectacles one. Say in source_note what was read and from where.

schema.description: One lens prescription as an optometrist issued it: the refraction for each eye and what the lenses are for. Written into records files by hand from the prescription or a transcription of it.

date.description: The day the prescription was issued, YYYY-MM-DD, which is the day of the sight test. This is the fact time.

expires.description: The day the prescription stops being valid, YYYY-MM-DD, as printed.

id.description: Identity, chosen by the writer: a slug for the provider, a colon, the date issued.

kind.description: What the lenses are for. A prescription for spectacles says it is not one for contact lenses, and the reverse.

left.description: The left eye's refraction, as printed.

sphere.description: Spherical power in dioptres, signed; positive is long-sighted.

cylinder.description: Cylindrical power in dioptres, signed: the astigmatism correction.

axis.description: The cylinder's axis in whole degrees.

add.description: The near addition in dioptres, for reading.

intermediate_add.description: The intermediate addition in dioptres, for screen distance.

prism_horizontal.description: Horizontal prism in prism dioptres, as printed, when any.

prism_vertical.description: Vertical prism in prism dioptres, as printed, when any.

note.description: Anything else the writer took from the prescription: what was ordered on it, a remark the optometrist printed.

practitioner.description: The optometrist as printed, with their provider number when the prescription shows one.

provider.description: The practice as the prescription names it.

right.description: The right eye's refraction, as printed.

sphere.description: Spherical power in dioptres, signed; positive is long-sighted.

cylinder.description: Cylindrical power in dioptres, signed: the astigmatism correction.

axis.description: The cylinder's axis in whole degrees.

add.description: The near addition in dioptres, for reading.

intermediate_add.description: The intermediate addition in dioptres, for screen distance.

prism_horizontal.description: Horizontal prism in prism dioptres, as printed, when any.

prism_vertical.description: Vertical prism in prism dioptres, as printed, when any.

source_note.description: What the writer read and where: the prescription itself, or a transcription of it, and which one.
